mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 2% and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, leading to wage inflation and increased production costs, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 5% and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1 million units signals increased demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST > 1,000,000 units and S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO shows a sustained 3-month decline and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY growth is below 2%, the real interest rate is high, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY growth < 2%, and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal savings (RSAFS) below $300 billion signals reduced consumer spending power, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS < 300,000 million and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200,000 signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS > 200,000 and S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% YoY and housing starts (HOUST) are below 800,000 units, it signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY growth < 2% and HOUST < 800,000 units
failure_condition: If GDPC1 YoY growth < 2% and HOUST < 800,000 units, and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.
